description: This file defines an AccountsService module that provides methods to perform CRUD operations on accounts via HTTP requests using imported API client functions (get, post, put, del).

methods.name: list(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches a list of accounts with optional query parameters.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific account by its id.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new account with the provided payload.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing account identified by id with the provided payload.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes an account identified by id.
